senses.gloss: निम निम, अस्, m. a pin, stake (?).

निमा नि-मा [cf. नि-मे], cl. 2. 3. P. A.
-माति, -मिमीते, -मातुम्, to measure; to adjust.

निमज्ज् नि-मज्ज्, cl. 6. P. -मज्जति, -मङ्क्-
तुम्, to sink into, sink down, dive, plunge into,
immerse one's self, bathe, be immersed or submerged
(e. g. अक्षि निमज्जति, the eye sinks; चिरं नि-
ममज्ज, he remained long under the water); to be
drowned; to penetrate into; to disappear, perish; to
immerse or submerge in water, cause to sink (e. g. into
hell, Mahā-bh. Ādi-p. 4156): Caus. P. -मज्जयति,
-यितुम्, to cause to dive, immerse, dip, plunge (any-
thing) into water, submerge, drown; (figuratively)
to cause to plunge or penetrate into a battle, lead
into the thick of a fight.

नि-मग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, plunged or immersed in,
dipped into, fallen into (water &c.), submerged,
sunk; gone down, set (as the sun); forcibly entered
into or penetrated; (with पर-लोकाय) entered
into the other world; sunk in, depressed, not
prominent; overwhelmed, covered.
—निमग्न-ना-
भि, इस्, इस्, इ, having a depressed navel.
—निमग्न-
मध्या, f. a woman having a depressed (and there-
fore slender) waist.
नि-मग्नक, अस्, आ, अम्, hiding one's self, lurking.

नि-मज्जत्, अन्, अती, or अन्ती, अत्, bathing, diving,
plunging in, sinking.

नि-मज्जथु, उस्, m. the act of diving or entering
into, plunging; (with तल्पे) going to bed, sleeping.

नि-मज्जन, अस्, ई, अम्, causing to enter or plunge
into (with gen.), immersing, absorbing; (अम्), n.
bathing, diving, immersion, sinking.

नि-मज्जमान, अस्, आ, अम्, sinking, plunging
into; immersed; being drowned.

नि-मज्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, plunged into the water,
drowned.

निमद् नि-मद्, Caus. P. -मादयति, -यितुम्,
to pronounce distinctly but slowly.

नि-मद, अस्, m. pronunciation which is distinct
[]
but slow, one of the seven degrees of pronunciation
(वाचः स्थानानि).

निमन्त्र् नि-मन्त्र्, cl. 10. A. -मन्त्रयते,
-यितुम्, to invite, summon, call (to a feast), entertain.

नि-मन्त्रक, अस्, m. one who summons or
invites, an inviter.

नि-मन्त्रण, अम्, n. inviting, invitation; sum-
moning, calling; a summons.
—निमन्त्रण-पत्त्र,
अम्, n. a written summons, a note of invitation.

नि-मन्त्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, invited, summoned,
convoked; bidden to a feast, entertained.
नि-मन्त्र्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be invited, to be called.

निमन्यु नि-मन्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. not angry,
unresentful, appeased.
निमय नि-मय. See नि-मे, p. 490, col. 2.
नि-मय, अस्, m. barter, change, exchange.

2. नि-मातव्य, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. see नि-मा),
to be exchanged or bartered.
नि-मान, अम्, n. measure. See अ-न्˚.
1. नि-मित, अस्, आ, अम्, measured out. See दुर्-न्˚.
2. नि-मित, अस्, आ, अम्, fixed in, fixed, erected.

निमित्त नि-मित्त, अम्, n. (probably con-
nected with नि-मा above), a mark, an aim; an
archer's butt, target; sign, token; prognostic, pre-
sage, omen [cf. दुर्-न्˚]; cause, motive, reason,
instrumental or efficient cause, (opposed to उपा-दान,
the material cause); निमित्त is used at the end of
a comp. in the sense ‘having as a motive or cause,’
‘caused or produced by,’ ‘occasioned by,’ e. g. विष-
निमित्ता पीडा, pain caused by poison; (अम् acc.,
एन inst., आय dat., आत् abl., अस्य gen., ए loc.),
because of, on account of, for the sake of, for the
purpose of, through.
—निमित्त-कारण, अम्, n. an
instrumental or efficient cause, (especially the Deity
considered as the agent in creation.)
—निमित्त-
कारण-ता, f. the state of being the efficient cause.
—निमित्त-काल, अस्, m. the period or moment of
time which may be regarded as causing any event;
any given or specific time.
—निमित्त-कृत्, त्, m.
‘omen-maker,’ a crow, raven.
—निमित्त-ज्ञ, अस्,
आ, अम्, acquainted with omens.
—निमित्त-ज्ञान,
अम्, n. ‘knowledge of causes or signs,’ N. of the fifty-
eighth chapter of the Kāma-sūtra by Vātsyāyana.
—निमित्त-तस्, ind. by or from a special cause or
reason.
—निमित्त-ता, f. or निमित्त-त्व, अम्, n. the
state of being a cause, causality, instrumentality.
—निमित्त-धर्म, अस्, m. expiation; any occa-
sional or special penance, rite, or obligation.
—नि-
मित्त-निदान, अम्, n., N. of a work.
—निमित्त-
भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become a cause or reason, being
a cause or means.
—निमित्त-मात्र, अम्, n. the
mere efficient cause or instrument.
—निमित्त-विद्,
त्, m. ‘omen-knower,’ an astrologer.
—निमित्त-
वेधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, hitting an aim, piercing the mark.
—निमित्त-हेतु, उस्, m. an efficient cause.
—नि-
मित्तहेतु-त्व, अम्, n. the being an instrumental
[]
or efficient cause.
—निमित्तार्थ (˚त-अर्˚), अस्, m.
the infinitive mood (in grammar).
—निमित्तावृत्ति
(˚त-आव्˚), इस्, f. dependance upon a special cause or
occasion.
—निमित्ती-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कु-
रुते, -कर्तुम्, to make anything a cause, to use as
a cause or means.
—निमित्ती-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति,
-वितुम्, to become a cause or reason for (with loc.).

1. नि-मेय, अस्, आ, अम्, (for 2. see नि-मे), to be
measured, measurable, anything the measure or value
of which can be fixed.

2. नि-मेय, अस्, आ, अम्, (for 1. see नि-मा), to be ex-
changed; (अस्), m. barter, exchange; [cf. नैमेय.]

निमि 1. निमि, इस्, m., N. of several kings of
Videha; of a son of Dattātreya; of a son of Ikṣvāku,
(this Nimi lost his body through the curse of
Vaśiṣṭha, and when the gods were willing to restore
it, requested that instead of receiving his former
shape he might occupy the eyes of all living creatures;
the request was granted, and in consequence of the
presence of Nimi, men's eyelids are ever opening
and shutting; cf. नि-मिष, and see Viṣṇu-Purāṇa
IV. 5); N. of the twenty-first Jaina Arhat of the
present Ava-sarpiṇī; of a son of Bhajamāna; of
Daṇḍa-pāṇi; of a Dānava; closing or winking of
the eyes, twinkling.
—निमिन्-धर, अस्, m. (fr.
निमिम् acc. sing. + धर), N. of a prince.

निमि 2. नि-मि, cl. 5. P. A. -मिनोति, -मिनुते,
&c., to fix in, dig in; to fix, erect.

नि-मित्तक, अस्, आ, अम्, (at the end of an adj.
comp.), caused or occasioned or produced by; (अम्),
n. kissing, a kiss.

निमित्तायमान, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. an unused Nominal
verb निमित्ताय), causing, producing.

निमित्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, operated on or influenced by
a cause, having a cause or reason.

निमिश्ल नि-मिश्ल, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. devoted
to, attached to (with loc.); (Sāy.) commixed, com-
mingling, mixing with, being mixed.
—निमिश्ल-
तम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. most attached to (with loc.).

निमिष् 1. नि-मिष्, cl. 6. P. -मिषति, -मे-
षितुम्, to shut the eyelids, wink, twinkle, blink.

नि-मिष, अस्, m. twinkling, winking, shutting
the eye; the twinkling of an eye considered as a
measure of time, a moment; morbid twinkling of the
eyes; N. of a son of Garuḍa (Mahā-bh. Udyoga-parva
3595); an epithet of Viṣṇu, (also अ-निमिष.)
—निमिषान्तर (˚ष-अन्˚), अम्, n. the interval
of a moment; (एण), ind. in a twinkling, in the
interval of a moment.

नि-मिषत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, winking, blinking,
closing the eyes.

नि-मेष, अस्, अम्, m. n. twinkling of the eyes,
(opposed to उन्-मेष); a momentary space of
time, a moment, a twinkling of the eye considered
as a measure of time; morbid twinkling of the eye,
morbid closing of the eyelid; N. of a mythical
being; निमेषं निमेषम्, every moment.
—नि-
मेष-कृत्, त्, f. ‘twinkler,’ lightning.
—निमेष-
तस्, ind., Ved. with regard to the shutting of the
eyes, (according to Mahī-dhara gen. sing. of the
pres. part.)
—निमेष-द्युत्, त्, or निमेष-रुच्, क्,
m. a fire-fly.
—निमेष-मात्र, अम्, n. only a twink-
ling, merely an instant; (एण), ind. in a twinkling,
in an instant of time, in barely a moment.
—निमे-
षार्धात् (˚ष-अर्˚), ind. in half a twinkling of the
eye, i. e. in less than an instant.
निमेष नि-मेष. See under 1. नि-मिष्, col. 1.
नि-मेषक, अस्, m. twinkling of the eye; a fire-fly.
नि-मेषण, अस्, ई, अम्, causing twinkling &c.

नि-मेषण; add — (अम्), n. the closing of the
eyes.

निमिह् नि-मिह्, cl. 1. P. -मेहति, &c., to
urine, sprinkle down urine.

निमील् नि-मील्, cl. 1. P. -मीलति, -मीलितुम्,
to shut or close the eyes, fall asleep, sleep; to close (as
flowers); to die, disappear; Caus. -मीलयति, -यितुम्,
to cause (one) to shut the eyes, to close; to kill.

नि-मीलत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, closing the eyes, winking
the eyelids, twinkling.

नि-मीलन, अम्, n. shutting the eyelids, winking
or twinkling of the eyes, winking; closing the eyes
in death; (figuratively) dying, death; (in astronomy)
immersion, complete obscuration, a total eclipse.
नि-मीला, f. shutting the eyes.

नि-मीलिका, f. shutting the eyes, winking, twink-
ling, blinking, conniving at anything; fraud, trick.

नि-मीलित, अस्, आ, अम्, closed, shut (as the eye),
winked, blinked; blinded, darkened, obscured; [cf.
रजो-निमीलित.]
—निमीलिताक्ष (˚त-अक्˚), अस्, ई,
अम्, having the eyes closed.

नि-मीलिन्, ई, इनी, इ, closing the eyes, having the
eyelids shut.

निमीव् नि-मीव्, cl. 1. P. -मीवति, &c., to
press on, press down.

निमीश्वर निमीश्वर, अस्, m. (with Jainas)
N. of the sixteenth Arhat of the present Ut-sarpiṇī.
निमूलम् नि-मूलम्, ind. down to the root.

निमृज् नि-मृज्, cl. 2. P. -मार्ष्टि (cl. 6. Ved.
-मृजति, -ते), -मार्जितुम्, -मार्ष्टुम्, to rub in,
rub upon, wipe, wipe off, wipe away, to cleanse
one's self (A.); to lead to, attach to: Intens., Ved.
-मामृजे, to wipe away, cleanse; to destroy:
Desid., Ved. -मिमृक्षति, (in Ṛg-veda I. 64, 4,
Sāy. considers नि-मिमृक्षुः as a Vedic redupli-
cated perf. = नि-मृष्टाः स्थिता बभूवुः; accord-
ing to some the meaning is ‘to flash down.’)

नि-मृग्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. devoted, attached to;
(Sāy.) excessively purifying or cleansing.

निमृण् नि-मृण्, cl. 6. P. -मृणति, &c., to
dash down, strike down.

निमृद् नि-मृद्, cl. 9. P. -मृद्नाति, -मर्दि-
तुम्, to crush, dash to pieces; to rub off.

निमे नि-मे [cf. नि-मा], cl. 1. A. -मयते,
मातुम्, to change, exchange for (with inst.), barter.

निम्न निम्न, अम्, n. (fr. नि or perhaps
rather fr. rt. नम् with नि or according to others fr.
rt. मन् or rt. म्ना with नि), depth, low ground, low-
land; a slope, declivity; gap, chasm or cavity in the
ground; a depression, deepening; (अस्, आ, अम्), deep,
profound (literally or figuratively); low (as ground),
depressed, sunk; (अस्), m., N. of a prince.
—निम्न-
ग, अस्, आ, अम्, going low or deep, going downwards,
descending; (आ), f. a river, mountain-stream; [cf.
गिरि-न्˚.]
—निम्न-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, going in deep
or low places; (अम्), n. a low place.
—निम्न-तल,
see under निन्द-तल.
—निम्न-ता, f. or निम्न-
त्व, अम्, n. depth, lowness, profundity.
—निम्न-
देश, अस्, m. or निम्न-भाग, अस्, m. a low or deep
place.
—निम्नोन्नत (˚न-उन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, low
and high, depressed and elevated, up and down.

निम्नैस्, ind., Ved. in deep places, low, down-
wards; [cf. उच्चैस्, नीचैस्.]

निम्ब निम्ब or निम्बक, अस्, m. (said to
be fr. rt. नी), a tree with bitter fruits, Azadirachta
Indica, the Nimb or Neemb tree, (the leaves of this
tree are chewed at funeral ceremonies); [cf. गिरि-न्˚,
तृण-न्˚.]
—निम्ब-तरु, उस्, m. the tree Erythrina
Fulgens or (according to others) Melia Sempervirens,
(it is considered as one of the trees of paradise.)
—निम्ब-रजस्, अस्, n. a particular high number;
[cf. महा-न्˚.]
—निम्ब-वती, f., N. of a woman.
—निम्ब-वीज, अस्, m. a tree (= राजादनी).
—निम्-
बार्क-करवीरार्चन-व्रत (˚ब-अर्˚, ˚र-अर्˚), अम्,
n., N. of a particular vow; N. of the seventy-seventh
chapter of the Bhaviṣya-Purāṇa.

निम्बूक निम्बूक, अस्, m. the common lime,
Citrus Acida; (also read निस्बू.)

निम्लुच् नि-म्लुच् (Ved. नि-म्रुच्), cl. 1. P.
-म्लोचति, &c., to set, disappear (as the sun).

नि-म्रुक्ति, Ved., or in later Sanskrit नि-म्लुक्ति,
इस्, f. sunset, setting of the sun, disappearance.

नि-म्रुच्, क्, f., Ved. sunset, setting of the sun,
evening; (क्, क्, क्), slack, loose.
नि-म्लोच, अस्, m. setting of the sun, sunset.

नि-म्लोचनी, f. (fr. an unused form नि-म्लोचन),
N. of the city of Varuṇa situated on the mountain
Mānasottara towards the west.
नि-म्लोचि, इस्, m., N. of a prince, son of Bhajamāna.

नीमानुय नीमानुय, अस्, m., N. of a Vaiṣ-
ṇava teacher.
